title: Asymmetric marked counting with coupled radical allocation
description: Proves the all-moduli Dirichlet boundary 0.8748559. Separate inverse and plain prime-slot selections increase the marked count gain; retaining the common-radical penalty strengthens the allocation estimate. Their combined source saving is 37/10000 before charged errors. Builds on the marked high-zero construction, Cycle61, and the listed predecessor proofs; inherited attribution is preserved.
